en: Oops! You broke a cup. Nobody was looking. What do you do?
Telling the truth leads to good deeds, and good deeds lead to Paradise!
So you go to Mama, and say: I broke the cup. I am sorry!
Telling the truth can feel hard... but Allah loves people who tell the truth!
And when you keep telling the truth, people trust you more and more!
So always tell the truth, even when it is hard.
Will you always tell the truth? Say: Yes, I will!
